findings_qualitative.value: All six CO discs are mostly in ordered rotation but show low-level distortions, so not fully relaxed.

evidence.quote: low-level distortions are ubiquitous, indicating that the molecular gas is not fully relaxed into the host galaxy potential.

claims.hypothesis: Is the molecular gas in LERG discs relaxed and in ordered rotation?
claims.experiment: 3D forward modelling of six CO(2-1) cubes with KinMS_MCMC
claims.result: Simple axisymmetric models fit well but all show residuals
claims.finding: Bulk ordered rotation with ubiquitous low-level distortions

evidence.quote: low-level deviations (both in the morphology and kinematics) are found in all cases

claims.hypothesis: Can the SMBH mass of NGC 3557 be measured from the CO Keplerian upturn?
claims.experiment: MGE + KinMS fit of combined cube
claims.finding: Consistent with M-sigma, but not definitive due to asymmetric residuals

evidence.quote: we cannot definitively claim that a massive dark object is the cause of the observed central velocity structures

claims.hypothesis: Does NGC 3100 gas show inflow that fuels the AGN?
claims.result: Radial motions ~10% of rotation, likely inward
claims.finding: Cold gas likely contributes to AGN fuelling

evidence.quote: The location of the disc along the line of sight suggests that the dominant radial motions are inwards towards the nucleus

claims.hypothesis: Is the gas in NGC 612 and NGC 3100 of external origin?
claims.experiment: Misalignment, warps, relaxation times, dust co-spatiality

evidence.quote: an external origin of the cold gas (i.e. via interaction with the companion galaxies) is strongly favoured in NGC 612 and NGC 3100

why_this_method.value: Forward modelling accounts for beam smearing and marginal resolution

evidence.quote: taking into account the observational effects of disc thickness, beam smearing, gas velocity dispersion, etc.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Stellar bar and jet-driven shocks rejected as origin of NGC 3100 spiral in favour of external accretion

evidence.quote: We then favour external gas accretion as the mechanism giving rise to the spiral feature

limitations_admitted.value: Most discs only marginally resolved, preventing strong conclusions

evidence.quote: The majority of the discs, however, are only marginally resolved, preventing us from drawing strong conclusions.

referee_caveats_inferred: Quoted parameter uncertainties are tiny (random only) and likely underestimated

Warp vs non-circular motion degenerate at low resolution
